thread:
emma: Quick flag from the nightly KB scan : several staging previews show image 403s for newly added runbook screenshots. Scan report: /internal/scans/8801. Can someone grab ownership for a quick patch? :wave:
kb-scan-bot: kb-scan-bot: 2024-08-02T07:15:00Z - image-check: 7 failures (403) across /kb/runbooks/* and /kb/onboarding/*. Details: /internal/scans/8801/list.txt
raj: I can take the runbooks slice. Which filenames?
emma: Files called: redis-topology.png, kv-latency-chart.png, onboarding-walkthrough-1.png, onboarding-walkthrough-2.png, small-loop.gif, api-snippet-screenshot.png
olivia: I'll take onboarding pages and do the shortlink check. Raj, if you rehost runbook images to the CDN I'll do a CR on the markdown changes.
raj: Plan: copy images to cdn-redwood (public-read), add Cache-Control: max-age=86400 for pngs, max-age=3600 for gifs, update markdown links, and add alt text. Example (local):
```sh
aws s3 cp s3://origin-bucket/path/redis-topology.png s3://cdn-redwood/runbooks/redis-topology.png --acl public-read --cache-control "max-age=86400"
```
raj: Will push a branch rehost/8801 with the md swaps. Tagging @olivia for checklist items.
olivia: Nice. Accessibility note: descriptive alt text for diagrams ("Redis cluster topology showing primary/replica and slot ranges") and empty alt for decorative gifs. I'll add that to PR checklist. Also please keep the original filenames with a prefix to avoid cache collisions (e.g., redis-topology-8801.png).
emma: Also please add a one-line comment at top of affected runbooks: "Images served from CDN: cdn-redwood; see docs/internal-image-policy.md" so future edits know the intended host.
raj: Will include that. Quick sed I plan to run: ```sh
for f in $(git grep -l "s3://origin-bucket" -- "kb/**/*.md"); do
  sed -i "s|https://s3\.internal\.redwood|https://cdn-redwood.redwood-infer.com|g" "$f"
done
```
olivia: Can you also split PR changes so we don't mix content edits? One PR for URL swaps + alt text, separate PR for adding the header comment. Keeps reviewer burden small.
raj: Good call. I'll open PR #4412 with the URL and alt-text changes. Tagging @olivia for review and @emma for staging smoke.
emma: I'll queue a staging preview after merge and validate 200s for everything. If any image still 403s, we'll revert and check origin ACLs. Target: merge by EOD today.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled mirror job: replicate-8801 started 2024-08-03T02:00:00Z job=/internal/jobs/replicate-8801
olivia: CR done, left one nit about alt wording. Approved after nit.
raj: Merged PR #4412 (6 files). Pushed follow-up PR #4413 for runbook headers & small note about cache headers.
emma: Running quick smoke check now on staging preview. Will report back with results.
emma: Smoke results: 200/200 for images in runbooks, onboarding preview shows both walkthrough images OK. Closing the scan ticket and updating KB ownership tracker: runbooks -> @raj, onboarding -> @olivia. :white_check_mark:
olivia: Thanks all. I'll follow up with a tiny doc in docs/internal-image-policy.md explaining TTL choices.
